$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：太陰.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 太陰化忌，你不宜在外地投資，更不宜見獵心喜。
rules.en: Tai Yin in Obstruction: avoid investing away from home, and do not chase what looks tempting.

rules.text: 太陰見｛天魁天鉞｝，你在外機會接二連三地來。
rules.en: Tai Yin meets ｛Tian Kui or Tian Yue｝: away from home, opportunities come to you one after another.

rules.text: 太陰與｛左輔右弼｝同宮，你在外總有人幫忙。
rules.en: Tai Yin shares the palace with ｛Zuo Fu or You Bi｝: away from home, there is always someone to help you.

source.quote: 太阴与辅弼同度，不外得人助

rules.text: 太陰在遷移宮，容易被外地或外國人接受；不宜與人競爭爭奪。
rules.en: With Tai Yin in your Travel Palace, people from other places accept you readily; avoid head-on competition.

source.quote: 便亦主易为异邦人接受
